Footer.description: AndresGilli is a modern, open-source landing page template built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, helping developers create beautiful websites faster.
Footer.componentsContent: From the beginning of the project, we provide access to a private git repository so you can see the source code of your website.
Footer.templatesContent: We deliver the operational website hosted on Vercel or any hosting proposed by the client that supports Next.js.
Footer.documentationContent: We offer a monthly subscription option for the maintenance of your website. This includes security updates, performance improvements, and technical support.
Footer.privacyContent1: Your privacy is important to us. We only collect information to provide you with our web development and maintenance services.
Footer.privacyContent2: We do not share your personal data, contact information, or project details with third parties without your explicit consent, except when required by law.
Footer.termsContent1: By hiring and using our web design and development services, you agree to comply with these conditions. Budgets and delivery times will be defined prior to the start.
Footer.termsContent2: We reserve the right to update these terms in the future. In any situation, do not hesitate to reach out to us through the contact section.

Faq.title: Common Questions
Faq.description: Everything you need to know about AndresGilli landing page template
Faq.answerOne: AndresGilli is built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and other modern tools. It uses best practices for performance and SEO.
Faq.answerTwo: Yes! The template is highly modular and well-documented. You can easily modify components, styles, and content to match your brand.
Faq.answerThree: We use next-intl for internationalization, making it easy to add new languages. Just add your translations to the messages folder.
Faq.questionFour: Can I use it for commercial projects?
Faq.answerFour: Absolutely! AndresGilli is open-source and free to use for both personal and commercial projects.
Faq.answerFive: Basic knowledge of React and Tailwind CSS is helpful, but our documentation makes it easy even for beginners.
